description: This file defines a utility enum 'AsyncTimeout' providing asynchronous timeout functionality using Swift's concurrency features. It includes two static methods: 'withTimeout' which executes an async operation with a timeout, and 'withTimeoutMs' which does the same using milliseconds.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous operation with a specified timeout in seconds, throwing a timeout error if the operation exceeds the limit.

methods.name: withTimeoutMs
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous operation with a timeout specified in milliseconds, internally converting to seconds and invoking 'withTimeout'.
